summary: This note is a wiki-style entry on the 1961 American romantic comedy film Breakfast at Tiffany's, directed by Blake Edwards and written by George Axelrod. It is loosely based on Truman Capote's 1958 novella of the same name and stars Audrey Hepburn and George Peppard. The note also includes a cast entry describing George Peppard's character, Paul Varjak, a writer and new neighbor who is a kept man.
one_line: A 1961 American romantic comedy film directed by Blake Edwards, starring Audrey Hepburn and George Peppard, loosely based on Truman Capote's novella.
key_facts: Breakfast at Tiffany's is a 1961 American romantic comedy film.
Breakfast at Tiffany's was directed by Blake Edwards.
Breakfast at Tiffany's was written by George Axelrod.
Breakfast at Tiffany's is loosely based on Truman Capote's 1958 novella of the same name.
Breakfast at Tiffany's stars Audrey Hepburn and George Peppard.
The film also features Patricia Neal, Buddy Ebsen, Martin Balsam, and Mickey Rooney.
Breakfast at Tiffany's was initially released on October 5, 1961 by Paramount Pictures.
George Peppard plays Paul Varjak, a writer.
Paul Varjak is nicknamed "Fred" by Holly, for his resemblance to her brother.
Paul Varjak is described as the new neighbor and kept man of apartment 2E.
